dialogues.speaker: Norma
dialogues.text: Oh, I was just on my way to buy some food.

dialogues.speaker: Norma
dialogues.text: Not groceries, though... I was going to get some restaurant takeout and bring it home with me. My husband has long since grown tired of my cooking...

dialogues.speaker: Norma
dialogues.text: I've heard that over in Liyue they have such a wide variety of different dishes that they've had to split it into several different cuisines...

dialogues.speaker: Norma
dialogues.text: I would love to visit if I ever had the chance.
